summary: Iter29 backend-only retest of the iter28 contact-chain fixes, all mocked with no real LLM calls. All 5 fixes are verified. FIX1: the duplicate name fills email, email_status and role into the existing contact and the search stops at 2 models. The xfail marker is gone and the test passes normally. FIX2: a non-quota error is recorded and the next model is tried; 'All models failed: …' is returned only when all 4 CONTACT_CHAIN models error. FIX3: AiCreditsOut after partial results saves them (ok True); AiCreditsOut on the first model still re-queues and re-raises. FIX4: _ask sets meta['model'] to the answering model, contacts_models stores actual models, and a repeated actual model is not counted twice. FIX5: the prompt contains 'short format only, e.g. firstname.lastname@domain.com'. The setup ValueErrors were caused by the tests, not the app. RCA: test_iter28 and test_iter27 each created their own event loop at import and called set_event_loop. When collected in one process, the Motor client bound to the last-set loop, while iter28's run() drove its own loop, giving 'The future belongs to a different loop'. The fake _ask signature was not the cause; it already accepted meta=None. Fixed by having both modules share asyncio.get_event_loop_policy().get_event_loop(). Results: 41 passed, 1 skipped (the RUN_REAL_LLM real call) across the 3 files. The suite was run serially (-n 0), with the default xdist addopts, and in reversed file order.

minor.issue: The check for an already-used actual model runs only AFTER _ask returns. If step 2 (gemini-3.1-pro) falls back to gemini-2.5-flash, step 3 (gemini-2.5-flash) is still called and its paid answer is thrown away. Verified by mock: calls=[sonnet, pro, 2.5-flash, opus], stored=[sonnet, 2.5-flash, opus]. Suggest skipping before the call (`if mdl in used: continue` at loop top), or merging the duplicate answer instead of discarding it.

When partial contacts are saved after AiCreditsOut, _ask has already set prospect_lock.ai_blocked_at and _blocked=True, while find_contacts returns ok True. This is probably intended (the engine pauses), but no log entry records that the search was cut short by credits.
Failure and credits paths still call _log_run with pe.PRO as the model, although the chain starts with Claude. Log the attempted models or errs instead.
Still open from iter28: the else (openai) branch sets web_search_options, which the universal key rejects.

action_items: Optional: in find_contacts, skip a CONTACT_CHAIN model that is already in `used` BEFORE calling _ask, to avoid a wasted paid call
Optional: log the real model or errs (not pe.PRO) in the failure _log_run calls
Optional: remove or guard the openai branch in _call
critical_code_review_comments: The merge fills only empty fields of the existing contact. A 'pattern' email from model 1 is never upgraded by a 'published' email from a later model, but this does not matter in practice because the loop stops on the first email.
With FIX4 skip logic, CONTACT_CHAIN[3] (opus) can now be reached when one actual model repeats, so it is no longer dead config.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_contact_chain.py (shared event loop; FIX1 test without xfail plus email_status/role/len asserts; credits_out split into requeue + keep_partial; non-quota now continues; new all_models_error_fails, actual_model_recorded, ask_meta_model, prompt_short_pattern)

seed_data_creation: The TEST_Brand28 prospect (id 99999928) was created and deleted for each test, and none remains. prospect_lock has no ai_blocked fields, and prospecting is still disabled (enabled False, phase 'contacts').
context_for_next_testing_agent: The test modules now share one asyncio loop, so they can run in the same process (serially or with xdist). Keep that pattern in new modules that use a module-level LOOP with Motor, otherwise you get 'future belongs to a different loop'. The real call needs RUN_REAL_LLM=1. Two old failures in test_prospecting.py and test_prospecting_24h_tailor.py (from iter28) were not rechecked.
